logic.long: Fast EMA crosses above Slow EMA on completed candle; prior fast ≤ prior slow
logic.short: Fast EMA crosses below Slow EMA on completed candle; prior fast ≥ prior slow
logic.exit: Close existing owned position on an opposite nonzero signal, then reverse if price/ATR checks pass; broker SL / TP may exit earlier
logic.stacking: One EA-controlled position; fixed 0.10 lot in current MultiFamily tester EA

logic.signal_timing: Signals use completed bars (shift 1 and 2), then execute at new candle on GOLDmicro H1
logic.note: Only parameters in parameters_used affect the indicator entry. Other generic parameter fields may be recorded but unused.
